mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video (v_name, v_type, v_rank, v_author, v_tag) VALUES (#{vName}, #{vType}, #{vRank}, #{vAuthor}, #{vTag})
mapper.select: SELECT id, v_name, v_type, v_rank, v_author, v_tag FROM video ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE video SET v_name = #{vName}, v_type = #{vType}, v_rank = #{vRank}, v_author = #{vAuthor}, v_tag = #{vTag} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, v_name, v_type, v_rank, v_author, v_tag FROM video
AND v_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND v_type = #{type}
AND v_rank = #{rank}
AND v_author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{author}, '%')
AND ( v_tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%') OR v_tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, ' %') OR v_tag LIKE CONCAT('% ', #{tag}, '%') OR v_tag LIKE CONCAT('% ', #{tag}, ' %') )
ORDER BY id DESC
